import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF295C_ {

    private static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
    private static int[][][] memoMin;
    private static int[][][][] memoCount;
    private static int budget;
    private static int totalFifty, totalHundred;
    private static boolean[][][] visited;
    private static long[][] nCrCache;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        budget = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (scanner.nextInt() == 50) totalFifty++;
            else totalHundred++;
        }

        initializeCombinationTable();
        initializeMinTable();
        int min = calculateMinimum(totalFifty, totalHundred, 0);
        if (min > 100000) {
            System.out.println(-1);
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        initializeCountTable(min);
        System.out.println(min);
        System.out.println(calculateCount(totalFifty, totalHundred, 0, min));

        writer.flush();
        writer.close();
    }

    private static void initializeCombinationTable() {
        nCrCache = new long[101][101];
        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) Arrays.fill(nCrCache[i], -1);
    }

    private static void initializeMinTable() {
        memoMin = new int[2][51][51];
        visited = new boolean[2][51][51];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 51; k++) {
                    memoMin[i][j][k] = -1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void initializeCountTable(int depth) {
        memoCount = new int[2][51][51][depth + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 51; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l <= depth; l++) {
                        memoCount[i][j][k][l] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static int calculateMinimum(int fifty, int hundred, int side) {
        if (fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1) return 0;
        if (fifty == totalFifty && hundred == totalHundred && side == 0) return 0;

        if (memoMin[side][fifty][hundred] != -1) return memoMin[side][fifty][hundred];
        if (visited[side][fifty][hundred]) return 1_000_000_000;
        visited[side][fifty][hundred] = true;

        int best = 1_000_000_000;
        for (int f = 0; f <= fifty; f++) {
            for (int h = 0; h <= hundred; h++) {
                if (f + h == 0) continue;
                int value = f * 50 + h * 100;
                if (value > budget) continue;

                best = Math.min(best, 1 + calculateMinimum(totalFifty - fifty + f, totalHundred - hundred + h, side ^ 1));
            }
        }

        return memoMin[side][fifty][hundred] = best;
    }

    private static int calculateCount(int fifty, int hundred, int side, int steps) {
        if (steps < 0) return 0;
        if (fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1) return steps == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (fifty == totalFifty && hundred == totalHundred && side == 0) return steps == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (steps == 0) return 0;

        if (memoCount[side][fifty][hundred][steps] != -1) return memoCount[side][fifty][hundred][steps];

        long result = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f <= fifty; f++) {
            for (int h = 0; h <= hundred; h++) {
                if (f + h == 0) continue;
                int value = f * 50 + h * 100;
                if (value > budget) continue;

                long ways = (nCr(fifty, f) * nCr(hundred, h)) % MOD;
                int sub = calculateCount(totalFifty - fifty + f, totalHundred - hundred + h, side ^ 1, steps - 1);
                result = (result + ways * sub) % MOD;
            }
        }

        return memoCount[side][fifty][hundred][steps] = (int) result;
    }

    private static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (r > n || r < 0) return 0;
        if (r == 0 || r == n) return 1;
        if (nCrCache[n][r] != -1) return nCrCache[n][r];
        if (r > n - r) r = n - r;
        return nCrCache[n][r] = (nCr(n - 1, r - 1) + nCr(n - 1, r)) % MOD;
    }

    static class Scanner {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public Scanner(InputStream in) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        }

        public Scanner(String fileName) throws FileNotFoundException {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(fileName));
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() throws IOException {
            return reader.readLine();
        }

        public boolean ready() throws IOException {
            return reader.ready();
        }
    }
}
